sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: Indonesia's downstreaming mandate (smelter quotas, export bans) is permanently rerouting global nickel and tin supply chains, favoring integrated local players with captive ore and energy costs.
China's aggressive stimulus and EV subsidy extensions are structurally lifting base-metal demand, but the effect is strongest on Indonesian mid-cap processors with direct China offtake contracts.
Energy transition capex (battery-grade nickel, tin for soldering) is creating a two-tier market: premium for high-purity output, discount for pig iron—favor companies with HPAL or refining tech.
sectors.ai: Buy selective momentum in nickel (INCO) and tin (TINS) on China stimulus and EV battery restocking, but trim ALKA/FPNI after parabolic runs—liquidity is thin and reversals are violent. Watch AGII for follow-through on coal-to-chemicals capex; avoid US-exposed names until Fed clarity. Position for Q4 earnings beats in smelters, not miners.

Watch for regulatory clarity from Jakarta as a catalyst to re-rate Indonesian crypto exposure.
